scope: Native translations execute the source cases against the compiled Workdeck binary using real PTYs and parsed terminal cells. This is not a waiver for broader renderer or complete cell-frame differential parity. Layout fixture shutdown closes its owned PTY like the source harness; lifecycle tests separately assert quit behavior.
